title: Deduplicate concurrent async calls
summary: Cache async results by key and share one in-flight promise between concurrent callers, without caching failures.
hints: Cache the **promise**, not the resolved value; that is what deduplicates concurrent calls.
Attach `.catch(() => cache.delete(k))` to the stored promise but return the original promise so callers still see the rejection.
Only delete if the cache still holds that same promise.
